packageRules.description: Stable-by-design libraries (reviewed 2026-08-17). These are feature-complete, not unmaintained: release inactivity is the intended steady state, so suppress abandonment reporting rather than tracking them as decaying dependencies.

Hold the hosted-runner move from ubuntu-24.04 to 26.04 (decided 2026-10-05, re-check 2027-01-11). It touches about 30 runs-on entries and every harden-runner egress allow-list at once, and hosted runners have been killing CPU-heavy jobs since 2026-09-01, so a second variable would make failures harder to read. Do it as its own PR on a quiet week, then remove this rule.

google/clusterfuzzlite has had no release since 2023-08-09 and is still the supported way to run ClusterFuzzLite in Actions (reviewed 2026-10-05). The cflite lane is green and the nightly Go fuzz lane covers the same targets, so suppress abandonment reporting rather than tracking it as a decaying dependency.
